question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

COMPLEX
solution:
The correct answer is '**simple**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Complex**' is '**Simple**'.
 
• **Complex**: made up of several connected parts and often difficult to understand; complicated. (अनेक परस्‍पर संबद्घ अंशों से निर्मित और प्रायः दुर्बोध; पेचीदा; जटिल)
 
 
• *Example: a **complex** problem/subject...*
 
 
 
• **Simple**: easy to understand, do or use; not difficult or complicated. (समझने, करने या प्रयोग करने में आसान, सुबोध, सुकर; कठिन या जटिल नहीं, सरल)
 
 
• *Example: This dictionary is written in **simple** English.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Simple.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Knotty**: full of knots. (गांठों से भरा हुआ)
 
• **Motley**: consisting of very different people, things, etc. that do not seem to belong together. (विभिन्न लोगों, वस्तुओं आदि का बेमेल मिश्रण; विविधतापूर्ण, नानविध, पंचमेल)
 
• **Mixed**: being both good and bad. (अच्‍छा और बुरा दोनों; मिश्रित)
